title: USNI News Western Pacific Pulse: Sept. 25, 2026
summary: ﻿﻿ The following is a summary of major ship movements and exercises in the Western Pacific over the last week. In U.S. 7th Fleet Area of Operations The Abraham Lincoln Carrier Strike Group (CSG) is underway following a two-day stop in Guam last weekend. The strike group includes aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72) with embarked Carrier Air Wing (CVW) and destroyer USS Frank E. Petersen Jr. (DDG-121). As of Friday, Abraham Lincoln has been deployed for 308 days. In the Philippine Sea Destroyer USS Carl M. Levin (DDG-120) is conducting routine operations in the Philippine Sea. Carl M. Levin
